text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Points: paired three-seed means. Whiskers: un-clipped 95% Student-t intervals (df=2).
Each protocol receives equal weight; fields are averaged within protocol.
Intervals describe training-seed variability, not uncertainty over captures or unseen protocols.
Blue circles: P-selected; orange squares: NLL-selected. Selection is source-only and TAPE-anchored.
